title: SLO burn on recommendation-service with connection wait events
symptoms: modest rise in CPU while requests queued
threads waiting to acquire a database connection
elevated p95 latency on the alerting service
observed_signals: latency jumped by more than 10x while CPU stayed only moderately higher
timeout-related WARN/ERROR rate on the service rose from near zero
connection wait time increased before error rate peaked
downstream_latency_ms on callers increased as they waited on recommendation-service

timeline.event: a config reload ran on recommendation-service
p95 latency on recommendation-service began climbing
pool stats showed a wait queue on recommendation-service
mitigation applied; latency and waits receded

contributing_factors: a config reload halved max pool size
no alert existed on utilization before 5xx
resolution: reverted the pool-size config change that had shrunk max connections
required a review for pool settings in the next deploy
paged on utilization remaining above 90% for 5 minutes
lessons_learned: do not raise pool size without checking for leaks
alert on pool utilization and acquire timeouts, not only on 5xx
